subject: Brand spotlight invitation — QuickCart pilot highlights
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@quickcart.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Brand spotlight invitation — QuickCart pilot highlights

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for running the pilot with our team last month. We pulled together a short summary of the results and wanted to check whether QuickCart would be open to a brief brand spotlight: a 2–3 line quote and an optional 15-minute call to help our content team capture a short testimonial and a hero metric for the case study.

High-level highlights from the pilot (attached):
- Average tail latency down ~2.3x for route-based shopping queries (P95 from 720ms -> 310ms)
- Per-request inference cost reduced ~40% after batching + KV caching configuration
- End-to-end throughput increased ~3x under your steady-state load, with consistent 99.5% success rate

If that works, a short quote like the example below would be super helpful: "Redwood helped us cut inference cost and improve query latency, enabling faster checkout experiences for our customers." No need to be formal — one line is fine.

Proposed next steps:
1) If OK, reply with a 2–3 line quote or approve a quick 15-min sync.
2) If you prefer, we can draft the quote and you can edit.

I attached the pilot-results-summary.pdf and a deliverable chart (throughput-trends.png) for reference.

Thanks again — really appreciate the partnership.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
https://redwood.com

Attachments: pilot-results-summary.pdf (PDF), throughput-trends.png (PNG)
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@quickcart.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 14:08:22 -0400
Subject: Re: Brand spotlight invitation — QuickCart pilot highlights

Sofia —

Really appreciate the clear recap and the attachments. The results look great and match what our analytics team saw during the pilot window. Happy to provide a short blurb and join a 15-minute call if that helps the content team.

Here is a quick 2-line quote you can use (feel free to tweak):
"Working with Redwood reduced our inference costs by roughly 40% while improving checkout query latency significantly. The performance uplift let us serve peak traffic without adding machines."

We're also fine with Redwood using the QuickCart name and logo for a short customer spotlight. If you need legal sign-off we can route a simple approval through procurement — should be quick.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Mercer
Head of Engineering | QuickCart, Inc.
alex.mercer@quickcart.ai

Alex, just to be explicit on usage: we plan a short customer spotlight page and a 1-page PDF one-pager that we may use on the Redwood site and in an outbound win kit. If procurement needs a short written approval, let us know and we can send a standard release form.

Best,
